title: The Saint, the Geist, and the Angel

entities.name: Saint Traft
entities.description: Young priest of the Church of Avacyn who became a saint for slaying demons; he died in a demon's trap generations ago.

entities.name: Geist of Saint Traft
aliases: the Saint Formerly Known as Traft
entities.description: The restless spirit Traft became after death, still striking at demonkind with an angel always nearby.

entities.name: Avacyn
entities.description: Angelic protector of Innistrad who has gone missing along with much of her angelic host.

entities.name: Withengar
entities.description: Demon-lord who laid a trap that killed Saint Traft; he was destroyed for a time by angels but returned to torment the world.

entities.name: The angel of Avacyn
entities.description: Traft's angelic companion, who perched on his roof, trusted him and was too late to save him; she watches over his geist.

entities.name: Church of Avacyn
entities.description: The church in which Traft served as a priest.

entities.name: Innistrad
entities.description: Plane afflicted by vampires and demons whose angel protector has vanished.

entities.name: Stensia
entities.description: Benighted, vampire-afflicted province of Innistrad where Traft lived.

entities.name: Shadowgrange
entities.description: Human village in Stensia where Traft's cottage stood.

entities.name: Needle's Eye
entities.description: Mountain pass beset by geists and vampires where the demon cult lured Traft.

entities.name: Ashmouth
entities.description: Sulfurous pit leading into the bowels of the world, an infernal gateway near Needle's Eye.

entities.name: Thraben
entities.description: Place with a Shrine of Traft.

events.summary: Traft hunts demons with Avacyn's angels along the Ashmouth and is recognized as a saint before his fortieth year.
events.quote: he became recognized as a saint before his fortieth year

events.summary: The demons plot revenge on Traft for frustrating their plans.
events.quote: So, as demons do, they laid a trap and plotted their revenge.

events.summary: Traft returns home to Shadowgrange and finds an angel on his roof and his wards scratched out.
events.quote: The wards above his door had been scratched out and neutralized

events.summary: Inside, Traft finds a demonic dagger through a map at Needle's Eye, a bloody message demanding he come without angels, and a girl's finger.
events.quote: Resting near the words was the finger of a young girl.

events.summary: Traft lies to the angel, telling her it is nothing, to save the child, and rides to Needle's Eye.
events.quote: "It's nothing," he told her. "I'll handle it."

events.summary: The angel senses the lie but trusts Traft and does not follow.
events.quote: She did as he wished, and did not follow.

events.summary: Traft fights through bats and a mad vampire, sacrificing his horse, to reach the crest of Needle's Eye.
events.quote: But he made his way to the highest point of the pass: the crest of Needle's Eye.

events.summary: Cultists with a possessed girl confront Traft; the cult-priest threatens to kill her if he calls angels and shrouds the pass in black fog.
events.quote: "You call your angels, and she dies," said the cultist.

events.summary: Traft refuses to call the angels or even use a warding spell and fights blind in the fog, killing cultists and the lead cultist.
events.quote: Within the dark fog, Traft's blade found cultist after cultist.

events.summary: Traft discovers he was tricked into killing with the cult-priest's bone dagger, doing a demon's bidding.
events.quote: Tricked into doing a demon's bidding yet again.

events.summary: Traft frees the girl from possession and sends her home.
events.quote: "Go," he told her. "Run, child. Run home."

events.summary: Withengar rises from the crack in the earth and Traft finally calls on the angels.
events.quote: As the horns and spreading wings of a great demon rose from the rent in the ground

events.summary: Withengar destroys Saint Traft; the angel and her attendants drive Withengar back for a time, but he resumes tormenting the world.
events.quote: The demon Withengar had destroyed the living saint, the famed slayer of demonkind.

events.summary: Traft never enters the Blessed Sleep and becomes a geist haunting the world.
events.quote: he never passed into the Blessed Sleep, and instead became a geist to haunt the world.

relations.quote: Traft was a young priest in the Church of Avacyn.

relations.note: Destroyed the living saint at Needle's Eye.
relations.quote: The demon Withengar had destroyed the living saint

relations.note: Demon slayer whose foe finally defeated him.
relations.quote: Remember to curse the name of Withengar when you attack for 6 on turn four.

relations.note: Angel who trusted Traft and later watches over his geist.
relations.quote: a certain angel is never far behind, always watching over him

relations.note: The spirit that Traft became after death.
relations.quote: instead became a geist to haunt the world.
the human village of Shadowgrange in Stensia
